LanguageData.ResearchOrganized_HideUnavailableTip: Shows only finished projects and projects that can be started now. Projects missing a prerequisite, techprint, research bench or other requirement are hidden until they become available.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized_HideFutureTechLevelsTi: Hides unfinished projects above your colony's tech level. Your tech level comes from your starting faction, and rises as Node Research's emergence projects are completed.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized_ShowTabCountsTip: Shows completed/total project counts next to each tab's name. Every tab's tooltip always shows project and research point totals, regardless of this setting.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized_SuppressEmergenceLines: Hides prerequisite lines into or out of Node Research's emergence nodes unless one end is selected. Turn off to always show those lines.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized_CombineAllTabsTip: Puts every technology except Anomaly, Gravship and Save Our Ship 2 on the Main tab, laid out in one block per tech level from left to right.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized_CombineIndustrialTip: Merges High and Late Industrial technologies back into the main Industrial tab.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized_CombineIndustrialInclu: Included in Combine All Tabs. Turn that off to choose this separately.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized_ColorCardsTip: Tints each finished project card with its tech level's color. Turn off for vanilla colors.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized_RequiresColorCards: Requires Color Cards by Tech Level.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized_AnchorIntro: A project with this many direct follow-ups on its own tab is treated as a hub: it keeps its place in the tree when a column is full, and the lesser projects move aside instead.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized_MajorAnchorTip: A major anchor starts a new column after everything before it and stands alone in it.
LanguageData.ResearchOrganized_WriteLayoutLogTip: Writes every project's column, row and hub type, and each hub's placement decisions, to Player.log whenever the layout is built.
